PFPI

GIRAFFES & MANIACS SHARE PFPI WEEK 5 TITLE;
ROUGHRIDERS LEAD LLAMAS BY 1 GAME OVERALL

Gracelin’s Giraffes and Mom’s Maniacs share PPFI Week 5 honors with 10-4 records, while Dick’s Roughriders maintain a 1-game season lead over Tati’s Llamas. Two bye teams and one tie game not included in standings account for the 14 games.

Greg’s Lobos fell into last place alone despite having the week’s lone Unique Hit with a Coonskin for Packers over Bears.

PFPI’s 23rd season of the modern era chugs on – now five weeks down and 13 to go in the steep climb to the Dad’s Dynamics Championship Trophy.
